info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Point of Service Management API
info.description: The Point of Service Management API facilitates the seamless updating of operational details related to point-of-service transactions across banking channels. This API allows authorized users to modify existing service parameters for enhanced functionality or compliance with business needs. Typical consumers include banking institutions and financial service providers looking to manage their point-of-sale systems efficiently. By providing a unified approach to service updates, this API plays a crucial role in ensuring operational accuracy and customer satisfaction.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the attributes of a specific point of service resource identified by RES-100045. Provide the necessary fields to modify as part of the request.

requestBody.description: This request body must contain the fields required to update the point of service identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. Ensure that the payload adheres to the specified schema to prevent errors during the update.
